system.description:
Your hands turn living flesh to putty, drawing, folding and reshaping the skin and organs of anything you touch.

Touch the victim to work the flesh. You can recast appearances within the limits of Malleable Visage, shift clumps of tissue, or ruin someone into scarred deformity: these touches deal no damage, but each strike inflicts one Repugnant Negative Trait (to a maximum of three from this power). By redistributing skin, fat and muscle you may also remove one — and only one — of the subject's Physical Traits and replace it with an extra Health Level, or reverse that operation.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Permanent (heals as aggravated wound on weaker generations)
